shloka_text: एतदाख्याय काकुत्स्थो भ्रातृभ्याममितप्रभः । लक्ष्मणं पुनरेवाह धर्मयुक्तमिदं वचः ।। 7.91.1 ।।
transliteration: etadākhyāya kākutstho bhrātṛbhyāmamitaprabhaḥ | lakṣmaṇaṃ punarevāha dharmayuktamidaṃ vacaḥ || 7.91.1 ||
translation: एतत् आख्याय having narrated this, काकुत्स्थः Rama, भ्रातृभ्याम् to his two brothers, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable splendor, लक्ष्मणं to Lakshmana, पुनः एव आह again indeed said, धर्मयुक्तम् इदं righteous this, वचः word.
explanation: Having narrated this, Rama of immeasurable splendor then again spoke these righteous words to Lakshmana in the presence of his brothers.
comments: Resolved on the Ashvamedha, Rama has the brahmins ordain it and a horse of auspicious marks released, and bids Lakshmana invite Sugriva and the monkeys, Vibhishana and the rakshasas, the allied kings, sages and entertainers -- a vast sacrificial ground is prepared in the Naimisha forest by the Gomati, with Bharata leading ahead the supplies, treasure, retinue and the queen-mothers.

shloka_text: वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ कश्यपम् । द्विजांश्च सर्वप्रवरानश्वमेधपुरस्कृतान् ।। 7.91.2 ।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭhaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca jābālimatha kaśyapam | dvijāṃśca sarvapravarānaśvamedhapuraskṛtān || 7.91.2 ||
translation: वसिष्ठं Vasistha, वामदेवं Vamadeva, च and, जाबालिम् अथ Jabali and then, कश्यपम् Kashyapa, द्विजान् च Brahmins and, सर्वप्रवरान् all the chief, अश्वमेधपुरस्कृतान् those appointed for the Ashwamedha sacrifice.
explanation: He spoke about inviting Vasistha, Vamadeva, Jabali, Kashyapa, and all other chief Brahmins who are appointed for the Ashwamedha sacrifice.

shloka_text: एतान्सर्वान्समानीय मन्त्रयित्वा च लक्ष्मण । हयं लक्षणसम्पन्नं विमोक्ष्यामि समाधिना ।। 7.91.3 ।।
transliteration: etānsarvānsamānīya mantrayitvā ca lakṣmaṇa | hayaṃ lakṣaṇasampannaṃ vimokṣyāmi samādhinā || 7.91.3 ||
translation: एतान् सर्वान् all these, समानीय having assembled, मन्त्रयित्वा having consulted, च and, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, हयं horse, लक्षणसम्पन्नं endowed with auspicious marks, विमोक्ष्यामि I shall release, समाधिना with proper ritual observance.
explanation: O Lakshmana, having assembled all these and consulted with them, I shall release a horse endowed with auspicious marks, with proper ritual observance.

shloka_text: तद्वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा त्वरितविक्रमः । द्विजान्सर्वान्समाहूय दर्शयामास राघवम् ।। 7.91.4 ।।
transliteration: tadvākyaṃ rāghaveṇoktaṃ śrutvā tvaritavikramaḥ | dvijānsarvānsamāhūya darśayāmāsa rāghavam || 7.91.4 ||
translation: तत् वाक्यं that statement, राघवेण उक्तं spoken by Rama, श्रुत्वा having heard, त्वरितविक्रमः of swift valor (Lakshmana), द्विजान् सर्वान् all the Brahmins, समाहूय having summoned, दर्शयामास showed, राघवम् to Rama.
explanation: Having heard that statement spoken by Rama, Lakshmana, of swift valor, summoned all the Brahmins and presented them to Rama.

shloka_text: ते दृष्ट्वा देवसङ्काशं कृतपादाभिवन्दनम् । राघवं सुदुराधर्षमाशीर्भिः समपूजयन् ।। 7.91.5 ।।
transliteration: te dṛṣṭvā devasaṅkāśaṃ kṛtapādābhivandanam | rāghavaṃ sudurādharṣamāśīrbhiḥ samapūjayan || 7.91.5 ||
translation: ते they, दृष्ट्वा having seen, देवसङ्काशं god-like, कृतपादाभिवन्दनम् one who had performed obeisance at their feet, राघवं Rama, सुदुराधर्षम् very difficult to overcome, आशीर्भिः with blessings, समपूजयन् they honored.
explanation: Having seen Rama, who was god-like, very difficult to overcome, and had just bowed at their feet, they honored him with their blessings.

shloka_text: प्राञ्जलिः स तदा भूत्वा राघवो द्विजसत्तमान् । आचचक्षे ऽश्वमेधस्य ह्यभिप्रायं महायशाः ।। 7.91.6 ।।
transliteration: prāñjaliḥ sa tadā bhūtvā rāghavo dvijasattamān | ācacakṣe 'śvamedhasya hyabhiprāyaṃ mahāyaśāḥ || 7.91.6 ||
translation: प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, स he, तदा then, भूत्वा having become, राघवः Rama, द्विजसत्तमान् to the best of the Brahmins, आचचक्षे he explained, अश्वमेधस्य of the Ashwamedha sacrifice, हि indeed, अभिप्रायं the intention, महायशाः the highly renowned one.
explanation: Then, the highly renowned Rama, with folded hands, explained his intention regarding the Ashwamedha sacrifice to the foremost Brahmins.

shloka_text: ते तु रामस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा नमस्कृत्वा वृषध्वजम् । अश्वमेधं द्विजाः सर्वे पूजयन्ति स्म सर्वशः ।। 7.91.7 ।।
transliteration: te tu rāmasya tacchrutvā namaskṛtvā vṛṣadhvajam | aśvamedhaṃ dvijāḥ sarve pūjayanti sma sarvaśaḥ || 7.91.7 ||
translation: ते they, तु indeed, रामस्य of Rama, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, नमस्कृत्वा having bowed down, वृषध्वजम् to Shiva, अश्वमेधं the Ashwamedha sacrifice, द्विजाः the Brahmins, सर्वे all, पूजयन्ति स्म they honored, सर्वशः in every way.
explanation: Having heard Rama's intention, all the Brahmins bowed down to Shiva and then honored the Ashwamedha sacrifice in every way.

shloka_text: स तेषां द्विजमुख्यानां वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् । अश्वमेधाश्रितं श्रुत्वा भृशं प्रीतो ऽभवत्तदा ।। 7.91.8 ।।
transliteration: sa teṣāṃ dvijamukhyānāṃ vākyamadbhutadarśanam | aśvamedhāśritaṃ śrutvā bhṛśaṃ prīto 'bhavattadā || 7.91.8 ||
translation: स he, तेषां of them, द्विजमुख्यानां of the chief Brahmins, वाक्यम् the words, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wonderful insight, अश्वमेधाश्रितं related to the Ashwamedha, श्रुत्वा having heard, भृशं greatly, प्रीतः pleased, अभवत् became, तदा then.
explanation: Then, having heard the words of wonderful insight from those chief Brahmins regarding the Ashwamedha, he (Rama) became greatly pleased.

shloka_text: विज्ञाय कर्म तत्तेषां रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत् । प्रेषयस्व द्रुतं दूतान् सुग्रीवाय महात्मने ।। 7.91.9 ।।
transliteration: vijñāya karma tatteṣāṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt | preṣayasva drutaṃ dūtān sugrīvāya mahātmane || 7.91.9 ||
translation: विज्ञाय having understood, कर्म the decision, तत् that, तेषां of them, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् he said, प्रेषयस्व send, द्रुतं quickly, दूतान् messengers, सुग्रीवाय to Sugriva, महात्मने to the great-souled one.
explanation: Having understood their decision, Rama then said to Lakshmana, "Send messengers quickly to the great-souled Sugriva."

shloka_text: यथा महद्भिर्हरिभिर्बहुभिश्च वनौकसाम् । सार्धमागच्छ भद्रं ते ह्यनुभोक्तुं महोत्सवम् ।। 7.91.10 ।।
transliteration: yathā mahadbhirharibhirbahubhiśca vanaukasām | sārdhamāgaccha bhadraṃ te hyanubhoktuṃ mahotsavam || 7.91.10 ||
translation: यथा as, महद्भिः with great, हरिभिः monkeys, बहुभिः many, च and, वनौकसाम् of forest dwellers, सार्धम् together with, आगच्छ come, भद्रं ते may you be well, हि indeed, अनुभोक्तुम् to enjoy, महोत्सवम् the great festival.
explanation: Come with many great forest-dwelling monkeys to indeed enjoy this great festival, and may you be well.

shloka_text: बिभीषणश्च रक्षोभिः कामगैर्बहुभिर्वृतः । अश्वमेधं महायज्ञमायात्वतुलविक्रमः ।। 7.91.11 ।।
transliteration: bibhīṣaṇaśca rakṣobhiḥ kāmagairbahubhirvṛtaḥ | aśvamedhaṃ mahāyajñamāyātvatulavikramaḥ || 7.91.11 ||
translation: बिभीषणः Vibhishana, च and, रक्षोभिः with Rakshasas, कामगैः who can go anywhere at will, बहुभिः many, वृतः surrounded, अश्वमेधम् the Ashwamedha, महायज्ञम् great sacrifice, आयातु let him come, अतुलविक्रमः of unequalled valor.
explanation: Let Vibhishana, of unequalled valor, come to the great Ashwamedha sacrifice, surrounded by many Rakshasas who can travel at will.

shloka_text: राजानश्च महाभागा ये मे प्रियचिकीर्षवः । सानुगाः क्षिप्रमायान्तु यज्ञं द्रष्टुमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.91.12 ।।
transliteration: rājānaśca mahābhāgā ye me priyacikīrṣavaḥ | sānugāḥ kṣipramāyāntu yajñaṃ draṣṭumanuttamam || 7.91.12 ||
translation: राजानः kings, च and, महाभागाः highly fortunate ones, ये who, मे my, प्रियचिकीर्षवः desirous of doing good, सानुगाः with their followers, क्षिप्रम् quickly, आयान्तु let them come, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, द्रष्टुम् to see, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.
explanation: Let all the highly fortunate kings who wish me well come quickly with their followers to witness this unsurpassed sacrifice.

shloka_text: देशान्तरगता ये च द्विजा धर्मसमाहिताः । आमन्त्रयस्व तान्सर्वानश्वमेधाय लक्ष्मण ।। 7.91.13 ।।
transliteration: deśāntaragatā ye ca dvijā dharmasamāhitāḥ | āmantrayasva tānsarvānaśvamedhāya lakṣmaṇa || 7.91.13 ||
translation: देशान्तरगताः gone to other countries, ये who, च and, द्विजाः Brahmins, धर्मसमाहिताः devoted to dharma, आमन्त्रयस्व invite, तान्सर्वान् all of them, अश्वमेधाय for the Ashwamedha, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana.
explanation: Lakshmana, invite all those Brahmins who are devoted to dharma and have gone to other countries for the Ashwamedha sacrifice.

shloka_text: ऋषयश्च महाबाहो आहूयन्तां तपोधनाः । देशान्तरगताः सर्वे सदाराश्च द्विजातयः । तथैव तालावचरास्तथैव नटनर्तकाः ।। 7.91.14 ।।
transliteration: ṛṣayaśca mahābāho āhūyantāṃ tapodhanāḥ | deśāntaragatāḥ sarve sadārāśca dvijātayaḥ | tathaiva tālāvacarāstathaiva naṭanartakāḥ || 7.91.14 ||
translation: ऋषयः sages, च and, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, आहूयन्ताम् let them be invited, तपोधनाः whose wealth is penance, देशान्तरगताः gone to other countries, सर्वे all, सदाराः with their wives, च and, द्विजातयः Brahmins, तथैव similarly, तालावचराः musicians, तथैव similarly, नटनर्तकाः actors and dancers.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, let all sages whose wealth is penance, all Brahmins who have gone to other countries along with their wives, and similarly musicians, actors, and dancers be invited.

shloka_text: यज्ञवाटश्च सुमहान्गोमत्या नैमिशे वने । आज्ञाप्यतां महाबाहो तद्धि पुण्यमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.91.15 ।।
transliteration: yajñavāṭaśca sumahāngomatyā naimiśe vane | ājñāpyatāṃ mahābāho taddhi puṇyamanuttamam || 7.91.15 ||
translation: yajñavāṭaḥ sacrificial enclosure, ca and, sumahān very large, gomatyā near Gomati, naimiśe vane in Naimisha forest, ājñāpyatāṃ let it be arranged, mahābāho O mighty-armed one, tat that, hi indeed, puṇyam meritorious, anuttamam unsurpassed.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, let a very large sacrificial enclosure be arranged in the Naimisha forest near the Gomati river, for that indeed is an unsurpassed meritorious act.

shloka_text: शान्तयश्च महाबाहो प्रवर्त्यन्तां समन्ततः ।। 7.91.16 ।।
transliteration: śāntayaśca mahābāho pravartyantāṃ samantataḥ || 7.91.16 ||
translation: śāntayaḥ peace rites, ca and, mahābāho O mighty-armed one, pravartyantāṃ let them be performed, samantataḥ all around.
explanation: And O mighty-armed one, let peace rites be performed everywhere.

shloka_text: शतशश्चापि धर्मज्ञाः क्रतुमुख्यमनुत्तमम् । अनुभूय महायज्ञं नैमिशे रघुनन्दन ।। 7.91.17 ।।
transliteration: śataśaścāpi dharmajñāḥ kratumukhyamanuttamam | anubhūya mahāyajñaṃ naimiśe raghunandana || 7.91.17 ||
translation: śataśaḥ by hundreds, ca and, api also, dharmajñāḥ knowers of dharma, kratumukhyam chief of sacrifices, anuttamam unsurpassed, anubhūya having experienced, mahāyajñaṃ the great sacrifice, naimiśe in Naimisha, raghunandana O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, let hundreds of knowers of dharma, having experienced this great and unsurpassed chief of sacrifices in Naimisha...

shloka_text: तुष्टः पुष्टश्च सर्वो ऽसौ मानितश्च यथाविधि । प्रीतिं यास्यति धर्मज्ञ शीघ्रमामन्त्र्यतां जनः ।। 7.91.18 ।।
transliteration: tuṣṭaḥ puṣṭaśca sarvo 'sau mānitaśca yathāvidhi | prītiṃ yāsyati dharmajña śīghramāmantryatāṃ janaḥ || 7.91.18 ||
translation: tuṣṭaḥ satisfied, puṣṭaḥ nourished, ca and, sarvaḥ all, asau that (people), mānitaḥ honored, ca and, yathāvidhi according to custom, prītiṃ joy, yāsyati will attain, dharmajña O knower of dharma, śīghram quickly, āmantryatāṃ let them be invited, janaḥ people.
explanation: O knower of dharma, let all those people be quickly invited, so that they will be satisfied, nourished, and properly honored, thereby attaining great joy.

shloka_text: शतं वाहसहस्राणां तण्डुलानां वपुष्मताम् । अयुतं तिलमुद्गानां प्रयात्वग्रे महाबल ।। 7.91.19 ।।
transliteration: śataṃ vāhasahasrāṇāṃ taṇḍulānāṃ vapuṣmatām | ayutaṃ tilamudgānāṃ prayātvagre mahābala || 7.91.19 ||
translation: śatam a hundred, vāhasahasrāṇām of thousands of cartloads, taṇḍulānām of rice grains, vapuṣmatām excellent, ayutam ten thousand, tilamudgānām of sesame and mung beans, prayātu let it go, agre in front, mahābala O mighty one.
explanation: O mighty one, let a hundred thousand cartloads of excellent rice grains and ten thousand cartloads of sesame and mung beans be sent ahead.

shloka_text: चणकानां कुलित्थानां माषाणां लवणस्य च । अतो ऽनुरूपं स्नेहं च गन्धं सङ्क्षिप्तमेव च ।। 7.91.20 ।।
transliteration: caṇakānāṃ kulitthānāṃ māṣāṇāṃ lavaṇasya ca | ato 'nurūpaṃ snehaṃ ca gandhaṃ saṅkṣiptameva ca || 7.91.20 ||
translation: चणकानां of chickpeas, कुलित्थानां of horse gram, माषाणां of black gram, लवणस्य of salt, च and, अतः therefore, अनुरूपं suitable, स्नेहं oil, च and, गन्धं spices, सङ्क्षिप्तम् collected, एव indeed, च and.
explanation: Therefore, suitable oil and collected spices, along with chickpeas, horse gram, black gram, and salt, should also be taken.

shloka_text: सुवर्णकोट्यो बहुला हिरण्यस्य शतोत्तराः । अग्रतो भरतः कृत्वा गच्छत्वग्रे समाधिना ।। 7.91.21 ।।
transliteration: suvarṇakoṭyo bahulā hiraṇyasya śatottarāḥ | agrato bharataḥ kṛtvā gacchatvagre samādhinā || 7.91.21 ||
translation: सुवर्णकोट्यः crores of gold, बहुलाः many, हिरण्यस्य of gold, शतोत्तराः hundreds more, अग्रतः in front, भरतः Bharata, कृत्वा having placed, गच्छतु let him go, अग्रे forward, समाधिना with careful arrangement.
explanation: Bharata should go forth at the head, having placed many crores of gold and hundreds more of other gold wealth, with careful arrangement.

shloka_text: अन्तरा पण्यवीथ्यश्च सर्वे च नटनर्तकाः । सूदा नार्यश्च बहवो नित्यं यौवनशालिनः ।। 7.91.22 ।।
transliteration: antarā paṇyavīthyaśca sarve ca naṭanartakāḥ | sūdā nāryaśca bahavo nityaṃ yauvanaśālinaḥ || 7.91.22 ||
translation: अन्तरा along the way, पण्यवीथ्यः market streets, च and, सर्वे all, च and, नटनर्तकाः actors and dancers, सूदाः cooks, नार्यः women, च and, बहवः many, नित्यं always, यौवनशालिनः youthful.
explanation: Along the way, there should be market streets, and all actors and dancers, as well as many cooks and perpetually youthful women.

shloka_text: भरतेन तु सार्धं ते यान्तु सैन्यानि चाग्रतः । नैगमा बलवृद्धाश्च द्विजाश्च सुसमाहिताः ।। 7.91.23 ।।
transliteration: bharatena tu sārdhaṃ te yāntu sainyāni cāgrataḥ | naigamā balavṛddhāśca dvijāśca susamāhitāḥ || 7.91.23 ||
translation: भरतेन with Bharata, तु indeed, सार्धं together, ते they, यान्तु let them go, सैन्यानि armies, च and, अग्रतः in front, नैगमाः merchants, बलवृद्धाः strong and old, च and, द्विजाः Brahmins, च and, सुसमाहिताः well-prepared.
explanation: Indeed, let the armies go forth with Bharata, and also the merchants, the strong and old, and the well-prepared Brahmins.

shloka_text: कर्मान्तिकान्वर्धकिनः कोशाध्यक्षांश्च नैगमान् । मम मातऽस्तथा सर्वाः कुमारान्तःपुराणि च ।। 7.91.24 ।।
transliteration: karmāntikānvardhakinaḥ kośādhyakṣāṃśca naigamān | mama māta'stathā sarvāḥ kumārāntaḥpurāṇi ca || 7.91.24 ||
translation: कर्मान्तिकान् workers, वर्धकिनः carpenters, कोशाध्यक्षांश्च and treasurers, नैगमान् merchants, मम my, मातः mothers, तथा similarly, सर्वाः all, कुमारान्तःपुराणि inner chambers of princes, च and.
explanation: Also, workers, carpenters, treasurers, merchants, all my mothers, and the inner chambers of the princes should similarly accompany them.

shloka_text: काञ्चनीं मम पत्नीं च दीक्षायां ज्ञांश्च कर्मणि । अग्रतो भरतः कृत्वा गच्छत्वग्रे महायशाः ।। 7.91.25 ।।
transliteration: kāñcanīṃ mama patnīṃ ca dīkṣāyāṃ jñāṃśca karmaṇi | agrato bharataḥ kṛtvā gacchatvagre mahāyaśāḥ || 7.91.25 ||
translation: काञ्चनीं golden, मम my, पत्नीं wife, च and, दीक्षायां in the initiation, ज्ञांश्च and those who know, कर्मणि in the ritual, अग्रतः in front, भरतः Bharata, कृत्वा having placed, गच्छतु let him go, अग्रे in front, महायशाः the greatly renowned one.
explanation: Rama commanded that the greatly renowned Bharata should proceed first, carrying his golden idol of Sita, who represented his wife for the initiation, and also leading those who were knowledgeable in the rituals.

shloka_text: उपकार्या महार्हाश्च पार्थिवानां महौजसाम् । सानुगानां नरश्रेष्ठो व्यादिदेश महाबलः ।। 7.91.26 ।।
transliteration: upakāryā mahārhāśca pārthivānāṃ mahaujasām | sānugānāṃ naraśreṣṭho vyādideśa mahābalaḥ || 7.91.26 ||
translation: उपकार्याः temporary dwellings, महार्हाः very valuable, च and, पार्थिवानां for the kings, महौजसाम् of great might, सानुगानां along with their followers, नरश्रेष्ठः the best among men, व्यादिदेश commanded, महाबलः the mighty one.
explanation: The mighty Rama, the best among men, commanded that splendid temporary dwellings be arranged for the powerful kings and their retinues. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 91 ।। Thus ends the ninety-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
